name: RapidTriage core forensics #51-#60 internal fixture validation

datasets.name: #51 reviewer workflow fixture assertions

required_assertions: Review marks preserve status, verification, assignment, priority, report inclusion, history/audit warnings, and #51 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; role-based multi-user review remains commercial blocker.

datasets.name: #52 compare fixture assertions

required_assertions: Compare preserves A/B/C baseline review, hashes, bounded text diff, status counts, specialized-diff warning, and #52 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; semantic binary/image/table diff viewers remain future work.

datasets.name: #53 hex viewer fixture assertions

required_assertions: Source preview preserves bounded hex rows, byte offsets, preview hash, byte-search citation support, source validation warning, and #53 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; full range export and source-byte citation package remain validation-gated.

datasets.name: #54 SQLite viewer fixture assertions

required_assertions: SQLite preview preserves read-only open, table/schema inventory, column/index metadata, bounded row preview, deleted/WAL warning, and #54 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; deleted-row/WAL and large database corpus validation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #55 email conversation viewer fixture assertions

required_assertions: Email preview preserves thread grouping, message order, participant/header fields, attachment inventory, mailbox limitations, and #55 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; native PST/OST/MSG conversation validation remains required.

datasets.name: #56 image gallery fixture assertions

required_assertions: Image rows/previews preserve metadata, hashes, thumbnail metadata, perceptual similarity bucket, tag/report hints, classifier limitation, and #56 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; dedicated gallery UI and ML similarity validation remain blockers.

datasets.name: #57 media transcript fixture assertions

required_assertions: Media preview preserves media metadata, source hashes, transcript sidecars, cue timestamps, verification warning, and #57 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; playback sandbox and ASR/transcript validation remain future work.

datasets.name: #58 OCR queue fixture assertions

required_assertions: OCR queue preserves queue items, sidecar hashes, retry state, engine metadata, native OCR warning, and #58 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; actual OCR worker execution and engine logs remain blockers.

datasets.name: #59 Korean OCR/translation fixture assertions

required_assertions: OCR/media flows preserve Korean hints, quality metrics, translation sidecars, confidence/engine metadata, human-review warning, and #59 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; human-certified translation and OCR calibration remain blockers.

datasets.name: #60 search deduplication fixture assertions

required_assertions: Search analysis preserves duplicate fingerprints, group counts, representative hit links, source/path references, near-duplicate warning, and #60 core_accuracy_gates.

datasets.notes: Internal fixture pass; UI collapse/suppression and fuzzy/media duplicate validation remain blockers.
